title: Reciprocals of translates of a transcendental element are linearly independent
statement: Let $F$ and $E$ be fields [def-weil-field] with a unital field homomorphism $\iota:F\to E$. Let $x\in E$ be transcendental over $F$, meaning that $P(x)\ne0$ for every nonzero polynomial $P\in F[t]$ (coefficients mapped by $\iota$). Then the family $((x-\iota(a))^{-1})_{a\in F}$ is linearly independent over $F$: for every finite set $S\subseteq F$, if $c_a\in F$ and $\sum_{a\in S}\iota(c_a)(x-\iota(a))^{-1}=0$, then $c_a=0$ for every $a\in S$.
